delete_issue_note_emoji_reaction.description: Remove an emoji reaction from an issue note. Pass discussion_id for discussion thread replies. Use this only after verifying the target; choose a get or list tool first when you need to inspect state without changing it. It changes or removes remote GitLab data and may be irreversible; it requires the necessary project or group permission and returns validation, conflict, permission, or rate-limit errors. When `project_id` or `group_id` is accepted, provide the numeric ID or complete URL-encoded path described by the schema; use required identifiers and pagination fields exactly as documented.

award_id.description: The ID of the emoji reaction to delete

discussion_id.description: The ID of a discussion thread. Required for notes that are discussion replies; omit for top-level notes.

note_id.description: The ID of a note (comment or thread reply)

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project
